summary: PREFILL_ACTIVATIONS=a4 is refused for the GLM Spark checkpoint, whose pre-QAD experts lose accuracy with it
compatibility: Only an explicit a4 with the Spark checkpoint (glm53-spark-tp2) changes: it now fails with the reason. An explicit B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL_MIN_TOKENS still enables it.
details: GLM Spark TP2 answered 456 of 500 needle-checksum requests with a4 prefill and 488 with a16; the QAD checkpoints (glm53-tp2, the glm53-flash profile) answered 477 to 494 with a4 and keep the option.
